data.title: GitHub - xzf-thu/VoiceMem: Infrastructure for the next generation of voice agents, designed to provide universal memory. It is divided into a left brain and a right brain, storing information and emotions respectively, while a fully streaming architecture eliminates latency at the fundamental level.
